title: Region-priority shim caused silent model downgrade for mixed-hosting tenants
creator: Diego Morales
description: Summary: Several enterprise customers reported intermittent increases in latency and subtle quality regressions. Investigation shows a routing policy shim applied during a recent policy merge step changed region priority scoring for mixed-hosting tenants. The shim lowered the implicit preference for customer-dedicated endpoints when a compatible hosted model with slightly higher cost was available in the same region. As a result, traffic was routed to a cheaper hosted variant with a different quantization profile, causing silent model downgrades (different tokenization/quantization artifacts) and customer-facing errors in a small percentage of requests. Affected surfaces: Hosted API, Dedicated pools, and Private (policy sync path). Impact: customer-facing quality regressions and latency spikes for ~2-3% of requests for affected tenants over the 2026-03-07 02:00–06:00 UTC window. Root cause hypothesis: policy-merge heuristic added a region-priority shim to prefer lower-cost model variants when a hosted model exists in the same region; the heuristic did not respect tenant-level dedicated pinning rules for cross-environment compatibility, and the fallback comparator allowed a model variant with incompatible quantization to be chosen. Repro steps: 1) Tenant with dedicated pool + hosted fallback configured. 2) Send high-throughput requests with long context lengths and tokens per request aligning with VM kernel selection edge cases. 3) Observe route decision JSON: region_score decreased by the shim delta; selected model id = hosted_variant_vq4 rather than dedicated_vq8 pinned model. 4) Confirm downstream: served KV cache misses and different per-token probabilities. Mitigation applied: (a) emergency policy hotfix rolled out 2026-03-07 07:15 UTC to reset region-priority shim for affected tenants; (b) temporary global route-safety rule enforced to prefer explicit tenant pins over cost heuristics until full patch lands. Work remaining: full fix in routing policy merge algorithm to (1) treat tenant pins as immutable for selection, (2) add a compatibility check between quantization profiles when comparing model variants, and (3) expand unit + integration tests around long-context kernel selection. Rollout plan: implement fix on routing service branch, run canary routing in staging, deploy to prod with canary traffic (5% -> 25% -> 100%) with a rollback playbook. Customer communication: coordinated postmortem + bugfix notes and mitigation timeline prepared for affected customers; support/SEs notified and given temporary routing override steps. Links: PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing/pull/5823, incident dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-03-07-region-shim, support thread: https://zendesk.redwood.ai/agent/tickets/11922
